Taita at a glance

Money, safety and the rest
  • 7 hrsby road from Nairobi, about 400 km. Mombasa is about 150 km away.
  • Jun–Octand January–February: the dry seasons, the most comfortable and the best for wildlife in Tsavo.
  • 2,200 m+Vuria, the highest peak of the Taita Hills. The hills are cooler than the plains.
  • 2 birdsfound nowhere else on Earth, the Taita thrush and the Taita apalis, in the hills' cloud forests.
